title: \[[arxiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.04062)\] QE-RAG: A Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmark for Query Entry Errors
why_relevant: Introduces a benchmark evaluating RAG robustness to noisy/corrupted user queries (typos, keyboard/visual errors) and proposes a robust retriever and query correction method, directly relevant to robust RAG under unreliable inputs.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on query-side noise rather than retrieved-evidence noise, which is a slightly different angle than most survey categories.
